# Setting up Git {#sec-setup-git}

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

# To trigger auto-linking
library(downlit)
```

Since Git has already been covered in the previous workshops, we won't cover
*learning it* during this workshop. However, since version control is a
fundamental component of any modern data analysis workflow and *should be used*,
we **will be using it throughout the workshop**.

## For those who have *not* used Git before

Type in the RStudio Console and follow the instructions:

```r {filename="Console"}
# There will be a pop-up to type in your name (first and
# last), as well as your email
r3::setup_git_config()
```

Please read through the [Version Control
lesson](https://r-cubed-intro.rostools.org/sessions/version-control.html) of the
introduction workshop. You *do not* need to do any of the coding tasks or
exercises. You will get plenty of practice and exposure to Git during the
workshop, as well as any help along the way for any issues you may have.

## For everyone

Run this check to make sure you have everything ready for the workshop:

```r {filename="Console"}
r3::check_setup()
```

The output you'll get for success will look something like this:

```text
Checking R version:
✔ Your R is at the latest version of {{< meta versions.r >}}
Checking RStudio version:
✔ Your RStudio is at the latest version of {{< meta versions.rstudio >}}
Checking Git config settings:
✔ Your Git configuration is all setup!
  Git now knows that:
  - Your name is 'Luke W. Johnston'
  - Your email is 'lwjohnst@gmail.com'
```

Eventually you will need to copy and paste the output into one of the survey
questions.
